verdict.rationale: The SOS has a dedicated business-entities forms page, which says all business forms can be submitted by mail or in person. That implies paper forms are obtainable from the public site, but no evidence states that the forms or their instructions are downloadable without an account. The new User Access requirement covers online Statement of Information filing on bizfile, not form downloads, so it does not contradict this story. Missing for 10: explicit evidence of downloadable form files (e.g., PDFs) on the public site, evidence that instructions accompany the forms, explicit confirmation that no account is needed, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
